<h3  id="mk-title-box-24" class="mk-title-box clearfix ">
	<span>
<p>Protect</p>
</span>
</h3>


<div id="text-block-25" class="mk-text-block   sm-text-capabilities">

	
	<p>Protecting users online by extending our partners’ threat protection services everywhere users take their devices.</p>

	<div class="clearboth"></div>
</div>

<div id="text-block-26" class="mk-text-block   ">

	
	<p style="font-size: .8em; line-height: 1.45em;"><strong>Solutions: <a href="/solutions/#dns-threat-protection">DNS Threat Protection</a>, <a href="/solutions/#sse-sase">SSE/SASE</a></strong><br />
<strong>Technology: <a href="/technology/#dns-forwarding">DNS Forwarding</a>, <a href="/technology/#secure-dns">Secure DNS over TLS and HTTPS,</a> <a href="/technology/#on-device-blocking">On-device Blocking</a></strong></p>

	<div class="clearboth"></div>
</div>

	<div class="wpb_single_image wpb_content_element vc_align_center  vc_custom_1712359355270">
		
		<figure class="wpb_wrapper vc_figure">
			<div class="vc_single_image-wrapper   vc_box_border_grey"><img class="vc_single_image-img " src="https://www.mobolize.com/wp/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/encrypt_red1024-70x70.png" width="70" height="70" alt="encrypt_red1024" title="encrypt_red1024" /></div>
		</figure>
	</div>

<h3  id="mk-title-box-27" class="mk-title-box clearfix ">
	<span>Encrypt</span>
</h3>


<div id="text-block-28" class="mk-text-block   sm-text-capabilities">

	
	<p>Encrypt is designed for automatic operation with configurable data traffic encryption across any network, such as public Wi-Fi. Configurable to encrypt only users’ unencrypted data for high-performance, low-cost security, or encrypt all data traffic for even more privacy. Provides secure browsing with encrypted DNS resolution supporting DoH/DoT.</p>

	<div class="clearboth"></div>
</div>

<div id="text-block-29" class="mk-text-block   ">

	
	<p style="font-size: .8em; line-height: 1.45em;"><strong>Solutions: <a href="/solutions/#privacy-relay">Privacy Relay</a>, <a href="/solutions/#sse-sase">SSE/SASE</a>, <a href="/solutions/#secure-wifi">Secure Wi-Fi</a><br />
Technology: <a href="/technology/#http-encryption">HTTP Encryption and Forwarding</a>, <a href="/technology/#secure-dns">Secure DNS over TLS and HTTPS</a></strong></p>

	<div class="clearboth"></div>
</div>
</div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-3"><div class="vc_column-inner "><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_single_image wpb_content_element vc_align_center  vc_custom_1712279712977">

			<div class="vc_single_image-wrapper   vc_box_border_grey"><img class="vc_single_image-img " src="https://www.mobolize.com/wp/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/bond_red1024-65x65.png" width="65" height="65" alt="bond_red1024" title="bond_red1024" /></div>
		</figure>
	</div>

<h3  id="mk-title-box-30" class="mk-title-box clearfix ">
	<span>
<p>Bond</p>
</span>
</h3>


<div id="text-block-31" class="mk-text-block   sm-text-capabilities">

	
	<p>Ensure users have seamless connectivity by automatically leveraging both Wi‑Fi and cellular data networks, such as in Wi‑Fi deadzones.</p>

	<div class="clearboth"></div>
</div>

<div id="text-block-32" class="mk-text-block   ">

	
	<p style="font-size: .8em; line-height: 1.45em;"><strong>Solutions: <a href="/solutions/#seamless-wifi">Seamless Wi-Fi</a>, <a href="/solutions/#secure-wifi">Secure Wi-Fi</a><br />
Technology: <a href="/technology/#wifi-cell-bonding">Wi-Fi + Cellular Channel Bonding</a></strong></p>

	<div class="clearboth"></div>
</div>

	<div class="wpb_single_image wpb_content_element vc_align_center  vc_custom_1712359209238">

		</figure>
	</div>

<h3  id="mk-title-box-33" class="mk-title-box clearfix ">
	<span>Access</span>
</h3>


<div id="text-block-34" class="mk-text-block   sm-text-capabilities">

	
	<p>Provide high performance fine-grain zero trust intranet access with SSO/OAuth via partner’s SASE/SD-WAN gateways, using advanced DPI and routing that avoids the usual connectivity issues and application breakage associated with legacy VPNs.</p>

	<div class="clearboth"></div>
</div>

<div id="text-block-35" class="mk-text-block   ">

	
	<p style="font-size: .8em; line-height: 1.45em;"><strong>Solutions: <a href="/solutions/#ztna">ZTNA</a>, <a href="/solutions/#sse-sase">SSE/SASE</a><br />
Technology: <a href="/technology/#http-encryption">HTTP Encryption and Forwarding</a>, <a href="/technology/#on-device-blocking">On-device Blocking</a></strong></p>
